name: Westwing Group SE
summary: Westwing Group SE operates as an e-commerce retailer in the home and living sector. It operates in two segments, DACH and International. The company offers furniture, textiles, kitchen accessories, and lighting and decor products, as well as private label products under the Westwing Collection brand and third-party brands. It operates in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Belgium, Croatia, Czechia, Denmark, Finland, France, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, and Sweden. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.
